Applying the core concept of 'Proclamation of Emergency', the impugned executive notification and show-cause order by the Legislative Secretariat / Returning Officer must satisfy legality, rational nexus, and proportionality. As reinforced by Article 352(1) specifies three exhaustive grounds: "war or external aggression or armed rebellion". The phrase "armed rebellion" was substituted for "internal disturbance" by the 44th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1978 to prevent political misuse.
